page.layout: One column of text, centred on the page; running head at the top above the text; no marginal notes; no page number printed.
page.notes: The running head "DEDICATIO" is set in small capitals. The last line ends with a catchword-like continuation "ma-" (hyphenated word beginning "schediasma-"), which is a line-end hyphen and not a separate catchword. Words "gratissimum" and "schediasmata" are read from the scan; "gratissimum" appears as "gratissimum" in print and "fiverunt" is printed as "fiverunt" (possibly "fiverunt" for "fuerunt"; left as printed). Line-end words after "ma-" are not visible in the scan beyond "ma-".
